DJI.note: States nothing on AI harms rules.
The AI is in road monitoring, a sector system.

facts.fact: DPCR says its CorridorVision AI, which detects road defects in vehicle video, is in deployment and calibration and has covered over 844 km on its 642 km corridor network.
DPCR says CorridorVision AI has identified 2,174 detections across four defect types in its first processing.
DPCR says it developed CorridorVision AI, training a YOLOv8 detection model on road images its annotators labelled, and deployed it on the RapidCanvas platform.
